summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K on May 31, 2026, disclosing routine managers' transactions under EU Market Abuse Regulation. The filing reports that Victoria Hanrahan, an other senior manager, acquired a total of 44,682 shares in two transactions on May 26 and May 28, 2026, at weighted average prices of $16.0179 and $15.5984 per share respectively, for a combined average price of $15.8117. There are no special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or capital returns; this is a standard compliance report of insider trading activity and does not constitute a special situation.
